summary: Iteration 10 — WORKOUT REVAMP (templates, exercise library, exercise stats, PUSH split log, lb/kg toggle) and NEW 4-digit Skool code (4882) VERIFIED end-to-end. BACKEND: 78/80 full-suite pass on parallel run (2 flakes were transient parallel-worker connect timeouts against the public preview URL — both re-run pass individually; identical pattern as iterations 8/9). New workout-revamp suite (16/16) 100% pass in isolated and parallel runs: GET /api/workout/templates returns exactly 8 templates with ids {push, pull, legs, upper, lower, arnold, fullbody, custom} and 'Barbell Bench Press' present on PUSH. GET /api/exercises returns {library:73 items, custom:[]} with categories Chest/Back/Shoulders/Legs/Arms/Core all present. POST /api/exercises/custom persists to user.custom_exercises via $addToSet, rejects blank name with 400, subsequent GET /api/exercises returns the custom row. GET /api/exercise/stats?name=Bench Press&rng=all returns full schema (totals/averages/max{weight,reps,volume}+dates/avg-max) with non-zero max_weight and max_weight_date populated (athlete@ has Bench Press history). rng=1w/1m/3m all return 200 with matching 'range' field. Unknown exercise returns zeroed shape. GET /api/exercise/log returns sessions[{date,sets:[{reps,weight_lb,rpe}],workout_name}] populated. GET /api/exercise/graph returns points[{date,weight,volume}] populated. POST /api/workouts/log with split_type='push' and 'Barbell Bench Press' logs successfully, awards XP, and correctly credits bench PR via the _PR_ALIASES map (Barbell Bench Press -> bench). Skool code updated: POST /api/profile/skool-verify with {code:'4882'} returns 200 + skool_verified=true; {code:'0000'} returns 400; legacy 'HUTCH-INNER-CIRCLE-2026' also returns 400 (correctly rejected). FRONTEND (Expo web, 390x844, athlete@): login lands on HQ; TRAIN tab shows 'SELECT YOUR SPLIT' with ALL 8 template cards (PUSH/PULL/LEGS/UPPER/LOWER/ARNOLD SPLIT/FULL BODY/CUSTOM) + HISTORY section listing prior workouts; tapping template-push opens ACTIVE SESSION > PUSH with all 5 exercises listed (each with 'VIEW STATS' link + '+ ADD FIRST SET' button) and the '+ ADD EXERCISE' CTA at the bottom; unit-toggle switches header pill LB<->KG live (verified). Add-set stepper spawns SET row with REPS/LB/RPE steppers and ✕ removal, and set-0-0-reps-up / set-0-0-weight-up / set-0-0-rpe-up all fire. '+ ADD EXERCISE' opens the EXERCISE LIBRARY modal grouped by category (Chest visible), with search that filters ('curl' -> Barbell Curl row visible), multi-select checkbox rows, and 'ADD EXERCISES' confirm that inserts the selected lift into the current session (Barbell Curl appeared in session after confirm). Custom-exercise create field ('+ ADD') present in modal header. VIEW STATS on an active-session exercise routes to /exercise-stats?name=<> with STATS/LOG/GRAPHS tabs and 1W/1M/3M/ALL range chips + unit-toggle in the stats header — schema keys all rendered (Total Sets, Total Workouts, Total Wt (lb), Avg Wt, Max Wt, etc). FINISH WORKOUT -> SESSION COMPLETE summary with '+60 XP' and 'Barbell Bench Press · 1 set · 80 lb top'; tapping summary-ex-0 opens exercise-stats. HISTORY -> expand a session -> tap an exercise row opens exercise-stats (verified). Settings screen shows SKOOL VERIFICATION with placeholder 'Enter 4-digit code', maxLength=4, keyboardType=number-pad — '4882' -> 'Skool verified! You now have Circle access.'; '0000' -> 'Invalid Skool verification code'. No red screens; no 500s. Deprecated console warnings (textShadow*, shadow*, pointerEvents) carried over from prior iterations — cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py workout/templates returns the WORKOUT_TEMPLATES list literal (8 entries) — deterministic, cheap, no DB call. Good.
server.py EXERCISE_LIBRARY has exactly 73 items across 7 categories (Chest 11, Back 14, Shoulders 9, Legs 14, Arms 13, Core 7, Olympic 5). Matches spec.
server.py add_custom_exercise uses $addToSet on user.custom_exercises so duplicates are silently ignored — safe for retries.
server.py _PR_ALIASES correctly maps 'Barbell Bench Press' -> bench so PUSH template lifts still update the user's bench PR. Verified end-to-end.
server.py exercise_stats returns avg_max_{weight,reps,volume} using session-tops (per-session max) — this is the right metric for progression charts.
server.py exercise/graph iterates reversed(sessions) so points are oldest->newest — chart-ready.
server.py skool_verify uses case-insensitive strip().upper() comparison and reads SKOOL_CODE from env (default '4882'). backend/.env pins SKOOL_VERIFICATION_CODE=4882.

frontend/app/(tabs)/workout.tsx: full session ↔ template ↔ library ↔ stats flow is co-located in ~340 lines. Uses units helper for lb/kg roundtrip on weight fields. testIDs are present on every interactive control (template-*, add-set-*, remove-*, add-exercise, unit-toggle, finish-workout, ex-stats-*, hist-*, hist-ex-*, summary-ex-*).

frontend/src/components/ExerciseLibraryModal.tsx: search filters library across both library and custom entries; multi-select via `sel` set; confirm returns selected names via `onAdd`. testIDs (lib-close, lib-search, lib-new-name, lib-create, lib-ex-<name>, lib-confirm) all wired.
frontend/app/exercise-stats.tsx: STATS/LOG/GRAPHS tabs + 1W/1M/3M/ALL range chips; unit toggle uses units.toDisplay for max/avg weights; renders max-*-date underlines gracefully when null.
frontend/app/settings.tsx: skool input has maxLength={4}, keyboardType='number-pad', placeholder 'Enter 4-digit code'. Verify wired to /api/profile/skool-verify with body {code}.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (updated: legacy skool code 'HUTCH-INNER-CIRCLE-2026' -> '4882' to match new 4-digit spec)

seed_data_creation: Workout-revamp suite registers isolated fresh users (revamp_<uuid>@test.com) for POST /workouts/log + POST /exercises/custom tests. Stats tests reuse the seeded athlete@ who already has 'Bench Press' history from prior iterations (deterministic across restarts).

In the SESSION COMPLETE summary, ONLY exercises that had sets logged are listed (empty exercises are filtered out server-side by the workout log). Settings page is reachable via /settings direct URL (no visible link from ME tab was needed for this run — direct URL worked). Skool verification input maxLength=4 and keyboardType=number-pad; the input silently blocks >4 chars. Legacy long code 'HUTCH-INNER-CIRCLE-2026' now returns 400 (intended). backend_test.py was updated to use '4882' — do not revert.
